methodology.processScope: The entire measured Node provider harness plus its native descendants, using the actual production port. This is not the Electron Desktop, 3D Office, or whole Extalia application RSS.
networkControls: isolated-provider: no prior global fetch in either Node parent
shared-fetch-prewarmed: both Node parents fetch an unmeasured loopback health response before idle/warmup; controls for a host that already loaded shared HTTP machinery
methodology.fixtureTransport: Prebuilt body buffers contain distinct SSE events; HTTP/TCP decides network chunk boundaries. Concurrent-delayed waits 200 ms before tokens to observe eight overlapping native children. Cancellation remains open until abort. Other fixtures have no artificial response delay.
methodology.primaryChildSpawn: Pass-through observer calls native spawn with the same binary, arguments and production options, reports PID/lifetime only, and returns the original child. No wrapper. Every native startup/close is included in latency.
methodology.primaryRssSampling: Targeted ps queries the Node PID and live native PIDs reported by the pass-through observer; separate instrumented diagnostics discover the wrapper descendants with ps process-tree scanning.
methodology.childOsDiagnostics: Separate successful runs wrap each native child in /usr/bin/time. These timings are excluded from latency and primary tree RSS.
limitations: Synthetic non-TLS loopback fixtures omit real network/provider latency, TLS, authentication, application UI and the rest of the host.
Tree RSS is an observed concurrent sum, never a sum of independent process peaks; ps sampling can miss short child lifetimes and brief peaks.
Polling adds observer load. Actual sampling gaps are reported. Primary child CPU from ps is a quantized lower bound; exact OS child CPU/peak come from separate successful diagnostics.
Cancellation diagnostics intentionally have no time wrapper: native child peak RSS/CPU on a killed short-lived child may be unobserved.
Parent CPU includes identical result/delta hashing in both variants; per-request total latency stops before final result hashing.
OS process RSS includes shared pages; process-tree sum is RSS accounting, not unique physical memory.
/usr/bin/time CPU is rounded to 0.01 s. A zero diagnostic CPU value means below measurement sensitivity, not zero CPU use; primary child CPU is not an exact total.
